01 Who we'll market to

A buyer from the US or Canada who wants a home near Avellanas that helps pay for itself.

Second-home buyers

They use the main house for vacations and rent the casita, or rent both when they're away.

Families

They want a separate space for visiting relatives without giving up their own privacy.

Relocating buyers

They want to live full-time near the surf at Avellanas and the golf at Hacienda Pinilla.

Overpricing costs timeCasa Arboleda has been listed since October 2025. Homes that launch above the market tend to sit, then sell after a reduction.
11 Our recommendation

Recommended list price range

$499,000to$549,000

Approximate estimate based on the comparables in this analysis.

Above the $480,000 multi-home listingCasa Sunny pairs a two-story modern main house with a separate casita.
Below the pool homes at $540,000 and upBuyers here expect a pool and will price that in. A plunge pool would support the top of the range.
Between the two recent salesAbove the ~$450,000 Mademoiselle contract nearby, and well under Casa Rio's ~$750,000 sale two blocks from Playa Avellanas.

About these numbers. This is a marketing analysis based on active listings and a recent contract in the area, not a formal appraisal. All values shown are approximations and estimates. The final list price is your decision.
